prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right agency depends on your goals, industry, budget, timeline and preferred working style. I can, however, help you find the best fit. A quick guide:

Questions I need to recommend agencies
- What are your primary goals? (e.g., generate leads, increase ecommerce sales, brand awareness, app installs)
- Which channels matter most? (SEO, PPC, social ads, content, email, CRO, analytics)
- Industry / target audience
- Monthly budget or total project budget
- Timeline / any hard deadlines
- Do you prefer a boutique agency, a specialized firm, or a larger full-service agency?

How to find highly rated SF agencies (quick checks)
- Clutch.co, G2, UpCity — filter by location, services, and read verified client reviews.
- Google Maps and Yelp for local ratings and recent reviews.
- LinkedIn to see client connections and leadership backgrounds.
- Request case studies that match your industry and goals.
- Ask for references and speak directly with a prior client.

What to look for in proposals
- Clear KPIs and reporting cadence (examples of past results with metrics)
- Transparent pricing and scope (what’s included vs. out-of-scope)
- Team bios — who will do the work (not just an executive)
- Testing plan and first 90-day roadmap
- Contract length and exit terms

Typical pricing ranges (San Francisco market)
- Small projects or audits: $3k–$15k one-time
- Monthly retainers for small–mid businesses: $3k–$15k/mo
- Full-service / larger programs: $15k–$50k+/mo
- Performance / enterprise engagements: $50k+/mo or project-based pricing

Suggested next step
If you tell me your goals, budget and timeframe, I’ll shortlist 4–6 San Francisco agencies that match your needs (not just the big names, but proven specialists for your use case). Would you like me to do that?
